goal: Implement persistent one-time, daily and weekly note reminders with honest delivery state, privacy-safe notifications and lifecycle reconciliation.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/thinkV2 after acceptance of V2-NOTES-LIFECYCLE-001. Implement approved PM B1-B10 in doc/product-baseline-decision-2026-09-16.md.

One enabled schedule per real note, stable reminder ID/revision, local date/time and weekly days. Enable/disable/edit controls and accessible reminder list. Viewing or dismissing notification does not cancel repeat schedule.

Local-wall-clock scheduling across reboot, time/timezone change and app update; deterministic DST gap/overlap behavior; idempotent occurrence/revision handling. Default inexact Android alarms with visible possible delay, no silent exact-alarm permission request.

Private notification text by default and correct real-note deep link. Permission/channel disabled means not enabled; keep saved configuration distinct from OS scheduling state. Cold-start reconciliation and retryable OS failure handling.
Integrate existing soft delete/restore: cancel pending alarm/notification on delete; restore configuration disabled until explicit user enable. No changes to existing note persistence semantics.
Persist missed/delivery state honestly; avoid missed-occurrence notification storms, do not equate notification posting with user reading. Use only existing dependencies/platform APIs where possible.

Meaningful clock/transition/reconciliation tests, offline build/lint and synthetic Android scheduling/notification/cancel/deep-link verification. Preserve evidence gaps for natural daily/weekly delivery and Xiaomi behavior.
out_of_scope: No backup import/export, ASR, calendar import, AI, graph, account, cloud notification service or publication.
No personal-device clock changes, battery setting changes, private data, new unreviewed dependencies or exact-alarm escalation without concrete need.
acceptance: One-time/daily/weekly rules work with stable IDs and revisions; same record repeats without duplicated notes; disable/edit cancels old work; weekly days are required and valid.
Fixed-clock tests cover future occurrences, DST gap/overlap, time rollback, duplicate broadcasts and missed recovery without storm.
Actual Android evidence for schedule, notification, direct note opening and cancellation; permission/channel blocked state is honest and retry restores operation.
Reboot/timezone/update/cold start reconcile persisted plans; stale revision cannot fire replacement plan; deleted note does not notify and restore does not re-enable silently.
Private body/title are absent from default lock-screen notification and diagnostic logs; failures retain recoverable saved settings.
Record natural daily/weekly repetition and real-device reliability as unverified unless actual evidence exists; host algorithms or compressed simulated time do not substitute.
evidence_required: RESULT; fixed baseline/final HEAD; files and purpose; B1-B10 matrix; test commands/results; APK hashes; Android evidence with exact environment; unresolved physical/family timing checks.
stop_conditions: Draft only until commander explicitly dispatches after previous task acceptance.
On new product semantics, unreviewed dependency or permission failure, report exact issue and continue independent bounded work; no automatic next stage.
